title: fix: match Bee Census responses by label, not title
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Responders rename the prefilled "[Bee Census]" title (#15816, #15817), so the quest never paid them and the AI triage commented on their survey.
- The quest search and the triage skip now use the `BEE-CENSUS` label, which the form applies and responders can't remove.
- Test: a renamed title with the label pays; an unlabelled issue doesn't.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: The label knows the bee
gist.blurb: Bee Census respondents can rename their issue titles and still collect their Pollen. The form’s `BEE-CENSUS` label now tells both the Quest and the triage bot what they’re looking at.
gist.summary: Bee Census Quest matching and AI triage now use the form-applied `BEE-CENSUS` label instead of the issue title, so renamed responses qualify for rewards and bypass triage comments.
gist.impact: Respondents who change the prefilled title can still receive their Quest reward, while only issues carrying the `BEE-CENSUS` label are treated as census responses.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a Bee Census issue as a paper form with a prominent BEE-CENSUS label and an edited title. Polli follows the label to a small Pollen reward, while a friendly CRT monitor robot routes the form past an AI triage desk; flowers frame the scene.
